How the remaining checks will be proved

Real user workflows

Use genuine login and MFA sessions. Check cash dates, scenarios, approval/recovery and export download/reopen. Compare actual delivery receipts and committed rows. Retain keyboard failures until their cause is proved and corrected.

Preview cases and controlled accounting tests establish no installed transaction, delivery or authenticated native pass.

Contention and load

500 synthetic tenants and 2,000 distinct real sessions; 60s warmup and 300s measurement. Cap: 100,000 timed requests and 900s total. Mix: 70% indexed reads, 20% ordinary forecast commands, 10% bounded analytics.

P95 limits: reads <500ms, commands <1,500ms, analytics <3,000ms. Real model calls, webhook delivery and operator activity are excluded from load.

Owner acceptance follows the completed evidence. Runtime setup approval is a separate decision and does not increase the accepted count from 3/109.
